title: test(rest): execctx-consumer-census.test.ts hand-counts 62 sites / 145 mentions / 16-46-12 catch shapes and is re-typed on every split slice — derive the census or retire the measurement file
body:
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Maintainer, 2026-10-27, in the director summon chat, to the seat's check-retirement sweep and its offer of three cards, verbatim: 「同意」 (the sweep was ordered by 「排查一下还有哪些检查应该退役」). Filed by the director seat (`session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708, sweep record 6433263738). ⛔ Not a claim. Batch-of: 11 (director seat, 2026-10-27). Dedupe: 600 newest open + closed issues grepped for the check's file name → 0 unless stated. Part of #26431. Reader: `domain:server`.

**Measured:** `packages/rest/src/execctx-consumer-census.test.ts` (header: *"This is a MEASUREMENT file. It repairs nothing and proposes nothing"*) pins at :848–873 `SITE_FILES` 18, `SITES` 62, 145 `resolveExecCtx` mentions, caught/bare/same-line 16/46/12 and "moved registrars 4/4"; its comments record a hand recount per `rest-server.ts` split slice; changed twice in the last 30 days for recounts. The question it answers (#13160: what an absent execution context means at each consumer) is a one-time reading, already recorded in the file's prose.

**Wanted:** either (a) retire the file and move its findings into a docblock on `resolveExecCtx` (the reading stays, the pins go), or (b) keep one derived assertion — every `resolveExecCtx` call site is in a caught form — computed from the tree, with no literal counts. The lane picks; (a) is the seat's reading of ④. **Acceptance:** no literal site/mention count remains in the file or its replacement; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test` green. **Size:** S. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.
